## What changes

Describe the interface action or developer workflow and its behavior before and after this change.

## Why

Explain the problem this resolves. Link a related issue if there is one.

## Validation

List the checks actually run and their results. For motion changes, include a short recording or describe the interaction tested at desktop and phone widths. Note any unverified behavior.

## Review

- [ ] The scope is focused, and application behavior and accessibility are preserved.
- [ ] Relevant checks pass; generated artifacts are synchronized when their source changed.
- [ ] Documentation and integration guidance reflect the final behavior.
